status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 73% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 73 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Government forces are massing near opposition leaders' homes while losing three towns as rival groups advance, and the UN is urging a halt to fighting in Baidoa amid worsening famine, displacement and flood risks. A UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four civilians, and Al-Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera that injured six people. Somali pirates continue to affect regional shipping, with Pakistani crew rescued after a hijacking and families receiving compensation for victims. Anti‑Somali rhetoric in the United States is amplifying threats to the Somali diaspora. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Regjeringsstyrker samler seg nær opposisjonelle lederes hjem mens de mister tre byer ettersom rivaliserende grupper rykker frem, og FN oppfordrer til en våpenhvile i Baidoa på grunn av forverret hungersnød, fordrivelse og flomrisiko. Et UAE‑droneangrep i Puntland drepte fire sivile, og Al‑Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera som såret seks personer. Somaliske pirater fortsetter å påvirke regional skipsfart, med pakistansk mannskap reddet etter en kapring og familier som får erstatning for ofrene. Antisosial retorikk i USA forsterker truslene mot den somaliske diasporaen. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
